summary_markdown:
A discussion was held regarding observed problems in the traffic calculation process, specifically when applying multi-source mirroring after primary models. The issue involves certain target facilities (without sensors) not being counted as weighted sources, even when coefficients exist in the database. This occurs because either old values are used or only partially weighted sources are calculated due to missing data at the moment of calculation.

Analysis pointed out two potential causes: 1) Residual records remain in `device_session_agg_ml_2` after deletion from `device_session_agg_ml_2_sharded`, and 2) Traffic records sometimes fail to finalize before the multi-source mirroring process begins, meaning not all sources are available for calculation.

It was determined that both insertion and deletion processes run asynchronously but can be modified to run synchronously.
decisions: The asynchronous nature of insert/delete operations in sharded databases needs modification to ensure synchronous execution.
action_items: [me] will update the relevant scripts with synchronous options for insertion and deletion processes.
